# Vault fixtures

Synthetic vaults for vault-level tests (D-50).

| Fixture | Used by | Status |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `new-empty/` | FR-VLT-02 AC-1, AC-3: the exact files a new empty vault gets (D-89, D-90, D-99) | **Approved by the owner 2026-10-11 (D-99).** Derived from BRD §5.1, FR-TYP-01/-03/-08/-12, FR-TSK-01…03 (D-25, D-70), FR-TAG-01/-05, FR-ATT-07, FR-FMT-09, FR-VLT-05. Not from the BRD, approved with it: icons (names from a common icon set), colors, preview attributes, the `review: locked` value, attribute names, Image/PDF metadata keys (`media-type`, `size`, `width`, `height`, `pages`), and the YAML layout |

Byte-exact: LF, UTF-8 without BOM, NFC. Universal attributes (FR-TYP-08: description, aliases, tags, source, icon, cover, review) are built in and not listed per type.

| Fixture | Used by | Status |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `search/` | MS2 search and switcher ACs in `docs/acceptance/search-navigation.md` (FR-SRC-01…04, FR-NAV-01). Hand-written; the test copies `new-empty/.tegg/` next to it to make it a vault. Contents: five objects that contain the word `rozpočet` (one untyped file without frontmatter), a phrase pair (`rozpočet projektu` adjacent vs. separated), a task with `priority: High`, an unreviewed Quick Note created `2026-10-06T00:30:00+02:00` (22:30 UTC the day before, for date-filter edges), an alias `Reading list`, a match on line 24 for snippet location, plus a template and a trashed note that contain the same words and must never appear in results | Draft for MS2, pending owner review with AP-46…AP-54 (`docs/acceptance/README.md`) |
| `shell/` | MS3 slice 3A app-frame ACs in `docs/acceptance/app-shell.md` (FR-UX-02, -03, NFR-OTH-02, FR-NAV-01 AC-12…, FR-SYN-06 AC-5, landing). Hand-written; the test copies `new-empty/.tegg/` into it (no file names clash) to make it a vault. Contents: three user types whose plural names test collation (`Cesty`, `Čajovny`, `Schůzky`: Czech order C < Č < S, English order Č = C, code-point order puts `Č` after `S`); objects per type for the Types-list counts (2 Pages, one of them untyped without frontmatter, D-103; 2 Quick Notes; 1 Task; 1 Schůzka; 0 for the other types); one object `Recepty/Svíčková.md` with `type: recept`, which has no definition (AP-65); a template and a trashed page that must never be counted or listed (FR-TPL-07, D-102); `Quick Notes/Nápad na čtvrtek.md` for the duplicate-name case of New object. NFD file names and `.icloud` stubs are created at runtime by the tests (git can't store NFD names reliably; a stub would make every test using this fixture show the placeholder warning) | Slice 3A; AP-65…AP-82 accepted (D-121…D-138) |
| `read-view/` | MS3 slice 3B read-view ACs in `docs/acceptance/read-view.md` (FR-EDT-10, FR-EDT-02, FR-TYP-08, NFR-REL-03 AC-3…5, FR-SYN-03 AC-10/11, FR-SYN-06 AC-6). Hand-written; the test copies `new-empty/.tegg/` into it. Contents: `Pages/Bloky.md` (every block and inline form of dialect §4–§5, incl. HTML with `<script>`/`onclick`/`<iframe>`, comments, math, footnote, block id `^abc123`, six callouts with an ASCII unknown type `[!budget]` and fold markers, two Mermaid blocks, query and `dataview` fences, a table with `\|`); `Pages/Odkazy.md` (link forms incl. alias, heading and block subpaths, case-insensitive and **NFD** target `[[Cíl]]` in NFD bytes, encoded Markdown link, same-folder duplicate `Dvojník`, unresolved `[[Neexistuje]]`, alias-only `[[Reading list]]`, links to the template and the trashed note, date links with and without a Daily Note, note/image/PDF/other embeds, tags incl. NFD `#Čeština`, non-tags, external links with `https`, `mailto`, `javascript:`, `file:`, `data:`, and non-links in code, math, comments and an HTML attribute); `Pages/Cíl.md` (target with headings `Úvod`, `Druhá kapitola` below 40 filler paragraphs, block `^blok1`, alias `Reading list`, and a last line `Odkaz ven: [[Odkazy]]` for FR-NAV-03 AC-4, D-168); `Pages/Dvojník.md` and `Quick Notes/Dvojník.md`; `Daily/2026-10-07.md`; `Pages/Vlastnosti.md` (every universal attribute and value format, empty values, nested map, unknown key); `Pages/Jen systémové.md`; `Pages/Bez hlavičky.md` (no frontmatter); five invalid-frontmatter files whose `@tegg/doc` error lines are 3, 6, 5, 5 and 1 (unclosed quote, list indentation, duplicate key, tab, unclosed `---`); a template and a trashed note that are never link targets. `Odkazy.md` is the only file with NFD bytes on purpose; don't re-save it in an editor | Slice 3B; AP-84…AP-95 accepted (D-140…D-151) |
